trifan.note: Our iterative CSA shortint port with unused upper columns/carries pruned.

parmesan.note: Author algorithm on TFHE-rs 0.5.4. Extra OS threads are restricted by Linux CPU affinity, not by Rayon count.

clot-bfv.note: Independent adaptation of CLOT's k=1 BFV-style tensor primitive; radix re-encoding, packing, extraction and restoration included. Not author code. Binary-key Gaussian and variance-additive model; general independently prepared operands, not identified ciphertext squaring. Native key/noise parameters differ from hybrid.

st-r2-n704.note: CC2 under the extracted key with pre-PBS key switching (reading R2 of the paper). n=704, sigma 2^-15.2 (lattice estimator 132.4 bits), N=2048; fastest decomposition with screen <= -128 at W16-256 (work-20261002/st-r2).

st-reported-r2.note: Paper Table 2 parameters with CC2 under the extracted key and pre-PBS key switching (reading R2), at the paper's CC2 scale 2^52. Noise assumed from Refined TFHE.

hybrid-grouped-rev-ld.note: hybrid-grouped-rev with carry-only reduction: linear digits (sum - 4*carry) where the digit variance stays within 40 V_PBS (1000 V_PBS in the wave feeding the final addition), chosen for AB and A=B; the final addition reads unrefreshed digits directly.

hybrid-cached-rev-ld.note: hybrid-cached-rev with carry-only reduction (linear digits), as hybrid-grouped-rev-ld.

hybrid-grouped-rev-no-cache-ld.note: hybrid-grouped-rev-no-cache with carry-only reduction (linear digits), as hybrid-grouped-rev-ld.

hybrid-8x8-rev-ld.note: hybrid-8x8-rev with carry-only reduction (linear digits), as hybrid-grouped-rev-ld.

hybrid-4x4-rev-ld.note: hybrid-4x4-rev with carry-only reduction (linear digits), as hybrid-grouped-rev-ld.

hybrid-8x8-rev-ld-sks.note: Control: chunk-product lookup without the row cache but with the shared reduction key switch of hybrid-cached-rev-ld.

tfhe-rs-ks28.note: TFHE-rs 1.6.1 mul_parallelized with the default 2M128 Gaussian set and the key switch (2,8) of our restoration. Per-PBS estimate under our model at the maximum noise level 5: 2^-148.8 (2^-128.9 with the default KS (3,5), matching the library label 2^-128.6).

hybrid-grouped-rev-mvb.note: hybrid-grouped-rev-ld with every reduction group that has a carry evaluated by one multi-value bootstrapping (Bernard et al., ePrint 2026/2310, fold factor); digit variance 8 V_PBS under uncorrelated extracted coefficients.

hybrid-cached-rev-mvb.note: hybrid-cached-rev-ld with every reduction group that has a carry evaluated by one multi-value bootstrapping (Bernard et al., ePrint 2026/2310, fold factor); digit variance 8 V_PBS under uncorrelated extracted coefficients.

bernard-mvb.note: Our reimplementation of Bernard et al. (ePrint 2026/2310), Ours (w/ shift), PG,12.8 of their Table 1 (n=930, KS (4,4), PBS (23,1)), heaviest rule, balanced order, TFHE-rs 1.6.1 carry propagation.

bernard-mvb-ks36.note: As bernard-mvb with the key switch (3,6), the cheapest change found that meets the whole-multiplication target at every width (phi_max 12.8 kept; lower phi does not help).

st-r2-n688.note: n=688, sigma 2^-15.05 (128.05 bits); tightest set with screen <= -128 at W16-256 from a finer search n=656..704; same decompositions as st-r2-n704.
